printer.title: 3D PRINTER
printer.description: Select your 3D printer model to automatically load its physical dimensions, kinematics geometry, and default features.

motherboard.title: Main controller board
motherboard.description: Choose the primary electronics control board installed in your printer electronic bay.

hotend_thermistor.title: Hotend thermistor
hotend_thermistor.description: Select the specific thermistor model used in your hotend for accurate temperature readings. If using PT1000, make sure the motherboard supports it.

4wd.title: XY - AXIS: 4x motors
4wd.description: Enable 4WD (4-motor CoreXY) setup for extreme acceleration, increased torque, and balanced belt tension.

part_cooling.title: Part cooling fan
part_cooling.description: Select the cooling solution mounted on your toolhead. Choose between a high-power CPAP system or a traditional 5015 blower fan.

aux_cooling.title: Auxiliary cooling
aux_cooling.description: Enable or disable an auxiliary chamber cooling fan, typically used for high-speed printing of PLA/PETG materials.

bed_fan.title: Bed circulation fan
bed_fan.description: Enable dedicated bed fans used to circulate air underneath the heated bed to normalize chamber temperatures.

motor_cooling.title: Active stepper cooling
motor_cooling.description: Enable this option if your printer is equipped with dedicated cooling fans for the XY stepper motors to prevent overheating.

motor_thermistors.title: Front motors T sensors
motor_thermistors.description: Enable real-time thermal monitoring via thermistors attached directly to the front stepper motors.

chamber_thermistor.title: Chamber temperature sensor
chamber_thermistor.description: Enable a dedicated thermistor to monitor the ambient temperature inside the printer's heated enclosure.

bed_surface_thermistor.title: Bed surface thermistor
bed_surface_thermistor.description: Enable a secondary thermistor mounted on the top surface of the heated bed for highly accurate print surface temperature readings.

z_rails.title: Z - AXIS: linear rails
z_rails.description: Specify the exact type of MGN linear rails used on your Z-axis assembly carriage (e.g., MGN12C or MGN12H).

bed_probe.title: Bed probe
bed_probe.description: Select the bed leveling sensor or surface probe installed on your toolhead. This injects the appropriate calibration macros.

adxl345.title: ADXL345 accelerometer
adxl345.description: Enable resonance testing and input shaping using the onboard or toolhead-connected ADXL345 accelerometer.

z_tilt.title: Z - TILT gantry
z_tilt.description: Enable automatic Z-axis gantry leveling utilizing independent Z stepper motors and calibration points.

default_current_xy.title: XY - current (RMS)
default_current_xy.description: Provide the manufacturer specified RMS current in Amperes (A) for the X and Y axis stepper motors.

default_current_z.title: Z - current (RMS)
default_current_z.description: Provide the manufacturer specified RMS current in Amperes (A) for the Z axis stepper motors.

default_current_e.title: EXTRUDER current (RMS)
default_current_e.description: Provide the manufacturer specified RMS current in Amperes (A) for the extruder stepper motor.

default_board.title: DEFAULT MOTHERBOARD MODEL
default_board.description: Choose the primary controller board configured for your printer.

default_driver_xy.title: XY - drivers
default_driver_xy.description: Choose the TMC stepper driver used for the X and Y axes movement.

default_driver_z.title: Z - drivers
default_driver_z.description: Choose the TMC stepper driver used for the Z axis movement.

default_driver_e.title: EXTRUDER driver
default_driver_e.description: Choose the TMC stepper driver used for the extruder motor.

mcu_main.title: Mainboard MCU Serial ID
mcu_main.description: Enter the unique serial path of your primary controller board. You can find this ID by running 'ls /dev/serial/by-id/*' via SSH terminal on your Raspberry Pi.

mcu_carto.title: Cartographer MCU Serial ID
mcu_carto.description: Enter the unique serial path of your Cartographer board. If left blank, default system fallback definitions will be used.
